usedFor: Sellbrite manages online listings, and “Create or Update Product” and “Create product and set inventory” keep stock current.

bestTemplate.name: “Receive Incoming Message” in Quo, then “Create or Update Product” in Sellbrite
bestTemplate.why: It writes price, images and identifiers to a product, so listings match your data.

watchOut: “Create product and set inventory” adds the product if missing, so it can create a listing you did not expect.
